verifications.claim: Easter Monday is not a federal holiday in the United States.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'In the United States, Easter Monday is not a federal holiday'; R3: 'this day is not a federal holiday in the U.S.'; R4: 'Easter Monday is not a federal holiday'; R5: 'not recognized as a federal holiday'; R6: 'not a federal holiday'; R2/R7: bill introduced because 'no federal holiday for Easter'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state it is not a federal holiday.

verifications.claim: Easter Monday is a public holiday in several other countries.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'public holiday in more than 50 predominantly Christian countries' lists Australia, Canada, Poland, etc.; R2: 'Most other Western nations already observe Easter Monday as a public holiday'; R4: 'public holiday in many countries, including Canada, the United Kingdom and much of Europe'
verifications.reasoning: R1 comprehensively lists many countries; others confirm.

verifications.claim: U.S. federal offices, banks, post offices, and schools typically remain open and operate on a normal schedule on Easter Monday.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R3: 'most government services... banks... mail services... remain open... Public school calendars vary'; R4: 'banks, post offices... remain open... some schools... may choose to close case-by-case'; R6: 'banks... USPS... government offices... open; schools vary by district'; R1: some schools close for spring break
verifications.reasoning: Clear support for federal offices, banks, post offices; schools vary by district/spring break, so less precise for 'typically'.

verifications.claim: USPS mail is delivered on Easter Monday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'U.S. Postal Service... typically carries out mail delivery'; R4: 'mail delivery and U.S. Postal Service post offices will be open'; R5: 'mail delivery... post offices will be open'; R6: 'USPS will operate normally... mail delivery services'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources directly confirm normal USPS operations including delivery.

verifications.claim: Legislation has been introduced to make Easter Monday a federal holiday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Moore... introduced legislation... Easter Monday Act'; R4: 'Easter Monday Act of 2025... sponsored by Sen. Eric Schmitt... H.R. 2951 by Rep. Riley Moore'; R7: 'Rep. Riley Moore... introduced a bill'
verifications.reasoning: Sources name specific bills and sponsors introduced in Congress.

verifications.claim: Legislation to make Easter Monday a federal holiday has not been passed.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'No hearings have been held... referred to committees'; R4: 'has not advanced... still sits... no action'; R7: 'no action has since been taken on the bill'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm bills introduced but stuck in committees, no passage.

verifications.claim: Easter Monday is observed as "Dyngus Day" in some areas.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Traditionally Polish areas of the United States observe Easter Monday as Dyngus Day... celebrations... in Chicago; Cleveland; Buffalo...'; also Polish Śmigus-dyngus on Easter Monday
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly states observation as Dyngus Day in specific US areas.
